title: Pin Art
description: A flat bed of steel pins on a black plate with a Beatles cover pressed through from behind: With the Beatles, the Let It Be grid, A Hard Day's Night. Raised pins grow into bright heads, so the cover reads as a halftone of steel. Drag to push your fingertip through; pick another cover and the pins roll over to it in one wave, or let them all fall flat.
intent: Pin art drawn as flat graphic design rather than a 3D render: each pin is a two-tone disc whose size and brightness are its height, so a real album portrait appears out of the grid and your fingertip leaves a bright trail.
